classification_purpose: Locate true endpoint stage and whole-light treatment units for the entire 17-paper sample; not sign-selected, no common meta effect fitting
interpretation: The 2023 review's interaction_type herbivory and pollination do NOT by themselves mean plant tissue damage, stigma pollen delivery, or seed output was measured

rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Legume flower-head resource and aphid numbers under spectrum and predator factors
rows.evidence_limit: Primary article full text; supplemental XLSX present; individual lighting installation design/SE not audited

rows.source_design: field nocturnal mouse risk and foraging
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Seed/bait GUD and rodent foraging, not live plant damage
rows.evidence_limit: Primary abstract/full-text public; no plant seed production

rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Moth transect, high-altitude flying activity, pollen carried on moths; no conspecific stigmatic delivery
rows.evidence_limit: Primary paper full text; pollen transport is not measured fertilization

rows.source_design: field lighting regimes / lamp spectra, five sites in four experimental runs
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Silene latifolia female-flower pollination success and seed traits; full-night positive vs partial/dark in published model
rows.evidence_limit: Original full article; source code available but original numeric SeedSet CSV unavailable in previously audited public archives

rows.source_design: urban observational ALAN intensity at 36 trees across 4 years
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Caterpillar biomass estimated from frass; living tree leaf damage or tree seed fitness not measured
rows.evidence_limit: Primary open article; tree/year frass repeats not independent lamp manipulations

rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Endangered kangaroo-rat patch use / forage behavior; no measured living plant fitness
rows.evidence_limit: Original published abstract available; primary design cluster variance not audited

rows.source_design: four lit meadows and four dark controls including spatial spillover
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Silene latifolia pre-dispersal capsule seed predation and Epilobium angustifolium seed/capsule production; adjacent-dark infestation elevated, lit-vs-dark plant-seed response unresolved
rows.evidence_limit: Original open full text with published Table 1 coefficients; some reproductive endpoint treatment effects not significant

rows.source_design: freshwater apple snail stream observational diel collection
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Pomacea canaliculata pedal-surface food gathering and diel activity, not measured aquatic plant losses
rows.evidence_limit: Primary article abstract; grazing impacts mentioned as ecological background

rows.source_design: Mediterranean rocky-shore light by snail-exclusion factorial
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Bacterial microbial biofilm diversity and photosynthetic-biomass responses; no flowering-plant reproduction
rows.evidence_limit: Original article full text; 4 sites, quadrats nested

rows.source_design: urban nocturnal macro-moth light pollution and canopy association
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Moth species richness / abundance; no observed plant visitation, stigma pollen or seed response
rows.evidence_limit: Original paper abstract; tree cover as environmental correlate

rows.source_design: flower/moth surface reflectance and spectrally resolved visual modeling
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Hawkmoth predicted flower colour perception and defence; no live field light treatment or pollen/seed output
rows.evidence_limit: Original open-access full research article: measured spectra feed receptor-color vision models

rows.source_design: direct lamp towers plus nonrandomized natural ambient skyglow gradient
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Hesperoyucca whipplei fruit recruitment and Tegeticula moth larval recruitment; higher skyglow positive, direct light fruit association weaker
rows.evidence_limit: Original full article; ambient gradient ≠ assigned ALAN trial; direct trap phototaxis separate from fruit gradient

rows.source_design: mechanosensory/visual learning under different illuminances in artificial flowers
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Manduca sexta artificial nectary targeting/hover times; nectar feeding, not actual plant herbivory or successful pollination
rows.evidence_limit: Original primary abstract full article: synthetic 3D flowers, not living reproductive plant

rows.source_design: single growth chamber factorial grass light by cricket addition (72 pots)
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Poa pratensis day21 plant height and post-cricket growth; light×cricket interaction p=.88, no confirmed light-mediated herbivore rescue
rows.evidence_limit: Original full Frontiers article, 2×2 18 pots each, 8 arranged blocks; pots not 72 independent lighting sources

rows.source_design: Lymnaea stagnalis laboratory nighttime artificial light effects
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Pond snail feeding/development/reproduction; no measured native flowering-plant fruit or seed output
rows.evidence_limit: Original public article abstract; aquatic snail organismal fitness separate from plant pollination

rows.source_design: vertebrate community ALAN/noise and oat-bait removal
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Oat food removal and vertebrate community foraging, not plants' realized seeds produced
rows.evidence_limit: Original article abstract: joint ALAN/noise, community and bait metrics

rows.source_design: bank vole lab partial night lighting plus grassland enclosure foraging
rows.actually_measured_endpoint: Millet giving-up density, nocturnal and following-day rodent foraging; no living plant seed production
rows.evidence_limit: Original Frontiers full paper: 21 voles lab, field enclosure animals nested
